playPlan.instructions: Look closely at both pictures and tap a spot that looks different.
playPlan.imageRequirements: For each screen, create two same-size versions of the scene. Keep the composition the same and change only the listed details. Do not put words or numbers inside the pictures.
playPlan.hotspotCoordinates: xPercent and yPercent are the center of each difference, measured from the top-left corner of either image.

interaction.onFound: Gently highlight the difference and keep it found.
interaction.onMiss: Offer a friendly try-again message without a penalty.
interaction.progression: Move to the next scene after all differences are found.

screens.title: Picnic Day
screens.sceneDescription: A cheerful picnic in a sunny meadow, with a blanket, a basket, and a kite in the sky.

differences.versionA: The blanket has a green circle in the center.
differences.versionB: The blanket has a green star in the center.
differences.hint: Look at the middle of the blanket.

differences.versionA: The kite tail has two bows.
differences.versionB: The kite tail has three bows.
differences.hint: Count the bows on the kite's tail.
Count the apples in the basket.

screens.completionMessage: Great looking! You found all three differences.

screens.title: Garden Visitors
screens.sceneDescription: A small garden with a watering can, bright flowers, and a butterfly near the flowers.

differences.hint: Look at the color of the watering can.

differences.versionA: The tallest flower has five petals.
differences.versionB: The tallest flower has six petals.
differences.hint: Count the petals on the tallest flower.

differences.versionA: The butterfly has two spots on its wings.
differences.versionB: The butterfly has three spots on its wings.
differences.hint: Look closely at the butterfly's wings.

differences.versionA: The snail's shell has one spiral stripe.
differences.versionB: The snail's shell has two spiral stripes.

screens.title: A Day at the Seaside
screens.sceneDescription: A calm beach scene with a striped umbrella, a sandcastle, shells, and a friendly crab.

differences.hint: Count the stripes on the umbrella.

differences.versionA: The sandcastle has a red flag.
differences.versionB: The sandcastle has a blue flag.
differences.hint: Look at the little flag on the sandcastle.

differences.versionA: There are two shells beside the sandcastle.
differences.versionB: There are three shells beside the sandcastle.
differences.hint: Count the shells in the sand.

differences.versionA: The crab has one claw raised.
differences.versionB: The crab has both claws raised.

differences.versionA: The beach ball has a yellow panel.
differences.versionB: The beach ball has a green panel.
differences.hint: Check the color panels on the beach ball.

screens.completionMessage: Fantastic spotting! You found every seaside difference.
